​ 

We are a family owned ice cream shop in Gulf Shores offering unique homemade cones and delicious authentic Italian ice cream (Gelato)

​

Looking for a unique experience while in Gulf Shores, Alabama?

​

Yumm Twister & Ice Cream aims to reinvent your food experience by offering unique and delicious ice cream creations! A combination of authentic Italian Ice Cream,  premium toppings inside of a one-of-a-kind handcrafted Twister cone. 

The Twister cones are freshly baked daily right before your eyes! 

Whether you choose our Signature Cones filled with Premium Italian Ice Cream, Milkshakes or Sundaes we are sure that you will love it!

​

At Yumm Twister & Ice Cream, we like to treat our customers to an experience that’s different from the average Ice Cream Shop. Our wide selection of Italian Ice Cream is a constant favorite among our customers. We pride ourselves on only carrying the highest-quality products.

​

Our Shop has inside and outside seating in a quiet area, right in the heart of Gulf Shores, Alabama.

​
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

Sunday - Closed

Monday - Closed

Tuesday - 12pm - 8:30pm 

Wednesday - 12pm - 8:30pm

Thursday - 12pm - 8:30pm

Friday - 12pm - 8:30pm

Saturday - 12pm - 8:30pmCome Visit!Hours

 
 
 
 

New favorite ice cream/gelato place while at the beach! We had a S’More, a Tiramisu, and a cup of Mint Chocolate Chip gelato.

The service was fantastic, there was no wait, and the food was incredible. Smooth, flavorful gelato in a delicious, fresh twister cake cone with top quality toppings.

Definitely worth the trip!Zac Head

 
 
 
 

The gelato itself was great, but the cone was absolutely amazing.

 

Pleasing to look at and delicious too. They are fun and exciting. 

 

The service was so friendly. 

An amazing place to enjoy a treat.Brianna Reed

 
 
 
 

The Tiramisu cone was awesome! 

 

I loved the pastry cone, the richness of the Gelato and the homemade tiramisu at the bottom of the cone!

​

Very unique place in an out of the way location!Joy BurroughsConnect with us!Like us on Facebook to keep in touch with our latest specials.Follow us on Instagram for a behind-the-scenes look into our shop and kitchen.FacebookInstagramYumm Twister & Ice Cream229 E 20th Ave, Suite 8, Gulf Shores, Alabama, 36542yummtcf@gmail.com251-281-8288bottom of page
